feedback.message: Retain R7 dual admission/continuation gates. Enrich continuation readout with bounded trajectory geometry, state-capacity context and semantic/version/trace identity separation.
Treat current LoopDynamicsReadout as parent. Candidate R8 fields refine observation only; RecurrenceDecision remains proposal-only and effect authority is never inherited through re-entry.
No GWT-specific syntax request. First compile LoopDynamicsReadoutR8 with existing G9 record/type/rule/control/effect machinery; reopen syntax only on an executable counterexample.

After BASE, preregister matched-compute H1 replay: state_delta-only vs R7 dual-gate vs R8 trajectory-capacity; cross with state-capacity levels, truthful/shuffled/no re-entry and receiver lesion/rescue. Bind receipts to semantic_state_hash/state_version_hash/trace_root_hash.

Treat pairwise TE/directed prediction gain as screening evidence when joint causes are plausible. Add conditioned multivariate/higher-order controls only where preregistered motifs justify their cost.
Continue preserving alternative routes and higher-order codependencies. Expose them to GWT estimators without collapsing them into one recurrence/emergence scalar.
Allow trajectory/capacity readouts and estimator scope to attach to exact episode/topology epochs. Graph activation/reachability still does not equal causal use or truth.
Persist/replay semantic, version and trace identities plus bounded trajectory-window and capacity-basis metadata. Benchmark storage/query cost before physical consolidation.
Integrate TC-RWC-R8 as OPEN refinement of the loop-of-loops/GWT program. Do not place adaptive recurrence performance on BASE critical path beyond representability and compilation.
